title: Ureong Gangdo
synopsis:
After missing the deadline to apply for a dorm, Jiho moves into a rented apartment, only to encounter a stranger named Dojin on the first day—whom he mistakes for a burglar. What begins as a chaotic misunderstanding quickly becomes a bizarre yet hilarious living arrangement, with the two navigating their sharp yet comical dynamic as roommates.

(Source: Anime News Network)
